title: Allow Engram ledger repair and deletion beyond the unconfirmed cap
outcome: The retired-authority preflight rejects every settings mutation and project deletion once a store exceeds MAX_UNCONFIRMED_RETIRED_ENGRAM_GRANTS_PER_STORE. If the recorded Engram binary path is permanently unavailable, the operator cannot point the project at a repaired binary and cannot delete the project, so fail-closed retention becomes an unrecoverable 409 lockout. Preserve the 16-entry protection for mutations that add another unconfirmed grant, while allowing repair-only mutations and deletion to converge without dropping or confirming pending tombstones.
acceptance: A store above the unconfirmed cap can update only the fields needed to restore a runnable Engram target and can delete the project; neither path drops unconfirmed entries or accepts a new grant hash; a repaired target retries pending revocations; deterministic tests cover repair and deletion above the cap.
